purpose: exploratory development comparison; no untouched final test
label: all incorrect first buzzes, including value-zero attempts
outer_split: existing frozen five-fold year_2024 whole-game split, seed 42
threshold_selection: 20% inner game holdout; maximum recall with empirical precision >= .6 and >=50 predicted incorrect buzzes; then refit on full outer training games
threshold_caveat: inner empirical precision is not a guaranteed outer precision bound
saved_compirt_threshold: .5; inner-selected thresholds are only available for the new logistic arms
frontier_caveat: retrospective_* metrics select on scored outcomes and are descriptive upper envelopes, not deployable threshold estimates
